text: why would u do  that? why cant you literally take that exact code that is there and just embed it verbatim, no 2 different things that have mismatch
resolution: Answered the correction directly: the previous embed diverged because I treated world_loader.zig's orchestration as unavailable/recreated a native Scene3D source instead of stopping until the real loader core could be shared. Confirmed the right fix is to extract the exact loader construct/render state into one shared module and have both standalone and /compiled call it.
